name: West Virginia University Potomac State College
academic_ranking: Two-year residential college and integrated division of West Virginia University (since 2005), accredited through WVU by the Higher Learning Commission. Offers 62 degree programs including associate of arts, associate of applied science, Bachelor of Applied Science, Regents bachelor's, and WVU's Bachelor of Science in Nursing. Approx. 1,193 students (fall 2020). Located in Keyser, WV. Source: Wikipedia and college site checked 2026-07.
financial_aid: West Virginia resident associate-degree base tuition and fees approx. $2,808/semester (~$5,616/year); non-resident approx. $7,020/semester (~$14,040/year); Metro rate (MD, PA, VA residents) approx. $4,452/semester (~$8,904/year), saving up to $5,000/year. Bachelor's-degree rates are higher. Federal and state financial aid plus scholarships offered through the WVU/Potomac State admissions cost-and-aid office. Source: admissions.potomacstatecollege.edu/cost-and-aid/tuition-and-fees checked 2026-07; academic year not stated on page.
facilities_notes: Athletics under the Catamounts brand at WVU Potomac State College, 101 Fort Avenue, Keyser, WV. Campus facilities include a baseball stadium (Golden Park), a recreation center, gymnasium, and a performing arts center. No softball-specific facility details published on the softball staff/roster pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NJCAA Region 20 Division II softball program. In the 2025 season the Catamounts advanced through the Region 20 tournament and finished as Region 20 Runner-Up after a championship series against Cecil College. Source: potomacstatesports.com softball news checked 2026-07.
